title: NTJ 2 Sorghum (NTJ 02): Characteristics
metaDescription: NTJ 2 sorghum is a sweet sorghum OPV variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: NTJ 2 sorghum is a sweet sorghum OPV variety, also sold or known as NTJ 02. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources.

heroImage.alt: Young corn seedlings in rows on freshly plowed ground in Bulacan, the kind of farm where NTJ 2 sorghum is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for NTJ 02, this is the same sorghum. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [sorghum variety finder](/crop-varieties/sorghum), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for corn and grains](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Days to harvest, by the seller's count: crop cycle about 3 to 4 months (general figure for these lines). No trial on record checks this figure yet, so treat it as the seller's own and compare with farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit sorghum fields most often: [Rice birds (maya)](/pests/rice-birds), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** Crop cycle about 3 to 4 months (general figure for these lines).
**Season:** Dry and wet season seed crops plus a ratoon crop at UPLB.
**Where:** MMSU Batac, Ilocos Norte, UPLB Los Baños, national trials.
Juicy stalks for sugar and ethanol.
Grown as seed crop and ratoon crop in UPLB trials.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: one of the five ICRISAT sweet sorghum lines found adapted in PH trials, the commercial variety UPLB used for its 2009 to 2011 fungicide trials. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant NTJ 2 sorghum
Sorghum stands drought better than corn, so it fits the dry season and dry uplands. Pick by use: grain for food and feed, or sweet sorghum for juice and syrup.

items.q: Is NTJ 02 the same as NTJ 2?
items.a: Yes. NTJ 02 is another name for NTJ 2. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of NTJ 2?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
